title: The middle layer will make or break enterprise AI agents
hook_text: Enterprise AI agents need a middle layer.
script:
Enterprise AI agents need a vital middle layer to succeed across modern corporate workplaces.
This architecture connects foundation models directly to backend corporate systems and secure databases.
Without proper orchestration tools, software workflows break down during complex multi step enterprise tasks.
Companies risk total operational failure if they ignore this critical software design layer.
Developers must build robust integration wrappers so autonomous agents can safely execute business logic.
Can your company tech stack handle autonomous agents safely?
